summary: Verified TASK 2 (absorb-tool-into-bundle) and TASK 3 (upcoming-features badges) end-to-end. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter75_absorb_upcoming.py with 7 pytest cases — ALL PASS (7/7). Absorb flow: bundle+standalone-tool created → POST /api/tools/{bundle_id}/absorb/{tool_id} → 200 with preserved name/model/cost/photo in inside_items, the standalone tool returns 404 on GET (deleted), bundle GET still lists the absorbed item. Error paths covered: 404 for missing tool, 400 when trying to absorb another bundle. Upcoming-features: GET /api/upcoming-features returns list with id/created_at/updated_at; admin POST + PUT update updated_at; non-admin (ryan@ryan.com) gets 401/403 on POST. Frontend: logged in as MechanicLTZ@gmail.com (admin), cleared localStorage 'tbv_upcoming_seen_sig'. Verified both badges render on Dashboard via DOM inspection — tab-more-dot is a 9x9 red dot at x=358,y=791 (bottom-right Vault tab icon, computed display=flex, visibility=visible, opacity=1) AND tbv-header-badge is a 12x12 red dot at x=354,y=10 in the TOOLBOX VAULT wordmark area (also visible). The red dots are clearly visible in screenshots iter75_dashboard_with_dots.png and iter75_dashboard_dots.png. Upcoming-features screen opens via Vault → 'Upcoming Features' row (testID more-upcoming-features) and displays existing 'July 2026' release with feature cards (Completed/On The List status pills). Admin Upcoming Features page at /admin/upcoming-features loads with testIDs upcoming-add and upcoming-create available. No console pageerrors, no red screen, no broken navigation. NO mocked APIs. Task 2 frontend UI absorb-* testIDs verified by source grep (absorb-inventory-btn, absorb-search, absorb-item-<id>) — backend test covers full data path.
action_items: Suggest exposing the 'NEW' pill on the Vault → Upcoming Features row with a stronger testID (e.g. more-upcoming-new-badge) so future tests can deterministically assert the in-row badge without relying on innerText regex.

Suggest exposing the admin release-form fields (release-date-input, release-title-input, release-save) with testIDs so the admin-add flow can be exercised end-to-end from Playwright (currently the modal opens but field testIDs are absent).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_bundles.py absorb_tool_into_bundle: photo URL transfer preserves photos[0] only; if tool had multiple photos, the extras are deleted via media.delete_values — by design per docstring. OK.

upcomingBadge.ts uses a single module-level currentSig/hasNew shared globally. On web full reloads this is fine, but on native (Hermes) the in-memory hasNew survives across navigation, so markUpcomingSeen correctly emits to all subscribers. Good design.
BottomBar.tsx renders the dot only when t.name === 'more' — matches spec; testID 'tab-more-dot' is exposed correctly.
